description: This file defines the LogicContext interface for the OpenMRS platform, providing methods for patient data retrieval, rule evaluation, data source access, and context configuration within the logic module.

classes.name: LogicContext
classes.description: An interface defining methods to evaluate logic rules, fetch patients and data sources, read data, and manage context parameters within the OpenMRS logic module.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient object for a given patient ID, ensuring the patient is within the current context cohort.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a logic rule or criteria for a specific patient, returning a Result object. Supports optional parameters and criteria-based evaluation.

methods.name: getLogicDataSource
methods.description: Fetches a LogicDataSource by its name.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified logic data source or based on criteria, returning a Result.

methods.name: setIndexDate
methods.description: Sets the date considered as 'today' within the logic context.

methods.name: getIndexDate
methods.description: Retrieves the current index date for the logic context.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the date considered as 'today' in the context.

methods.name: setGlobalParameter
methods.description: Sets a global parameter value within the logic context.

methods.name: getGlobalParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global parameter.

methods.name: getGlobalParameters
methods.description: Returns all global parameter names defined in the context.
